summary: This is a Form 6-K submission by Grupo Televisa, S.A.B. reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing contains a press release detailing consolidated revenue decline of 3.1%, operating segment income increase of 5.2%, and segment reorganization integrating Cable and Sky into a single Telecom segment. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no transaction or corporate action. It includes an earnings call notice but no event triggering a special-situation classification.
